About Minjingu Mines & Fertiliser

Minjingu Mines & Fertiliser Ltd. mines its own natural phosphate rock near Babati, Tanzania, and turns it into fertiliser formulated for East Africa's naturally acidic soils and cash crops. It is the only company in East Africa that mines its own raw material and manufactures finished fertiliser from it — sold under both the Minjingu Mines & Fertiliser Ltd. (Tanzania) and Minjingu Mines & Fertiliser Kenya Ltd. brands.

⛏️

Own Phosphate Mine

Beneficiated rock phosphate mined locally near Babati, Manyara Region.

🌱

7 Fertiliser Blends

Six compound NPK blends plus one fully organic phosphate — for planting, growing, and top dressing.

✅

Registered & Certified

Every product is TFRA-registered and TBS/EAS approved; the organic line is TanCert certified.

🌍

Tanzania & Kenya

Offices and sales support in both Arusha, Tanzania and Nairobi, Kenya.
